# AUTHORED from vLLM v0.27.1's source, NOT captured from a pod.
# The JSON document vLLM v0.27.1 answers `POST /v1/messages/count_tokens` with when the gateway
# sends it the body of 2-tool-result.request.txt as the relay rewrote it: the input's token
# count, and the same count again as `context_management.original_input_tokens`. Sources under
# https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/v0.27.1/ (tag v0.27.1, commit 6e448d0ea9bf):
# vllm/entrypoints/anthropic/api_router.py:95-133 (the `/v1/messages/count_tokens` route: a
# compact JSONResponse of the response model, `exclude_none`), vllm/entrypoints/anthropic/
# serving.py:1020-1025 (the response: `input_tokens` and a `context_management` of
# `original_input_tokens`, both the summed prompt token ids) and
# vllm/entrypoints/anthropic/protocol.py:248-251 and 280-284 (the two models, fields in that
# order).
# The count is illustrative, not a tokenizer's: chosen so that the window of 65536 the consumer's
# server ran with leaves 31999 tokens, one fewer than the request's `max_tokens` of 32000. The
# file's final newline is not part of vLLM's answer, which the test does not depend on.
{"input_tokens":33537,"context_management":{"original_input_tokens":33537}}
